definitions: Force (an unwelcome decision or an unfair burden) on someone.
Require (a duty, tax, or impost) to be paid, levied, or obeyed.
Take advantage of someone by demanding their attention or commitment too often.
Place a restriction on (someone or something).
examples: The council imposes a ban on parking.
The government imposes taxes on luxury goods.
He felt he was imposing on her hospitality.
The new rules impose strict limits on spending.
